facts.fact: Google's Antigravity desktop download is stated to be available on macOS, Windows, Linux, and Googlebook.
facts.quote: Available on macOS, Windows, Linux, and Googlebook

facts.fact: According to the vendor, the Antigravity SDK lets developers prototype custom agents with simple Python scripts on top of the Antigravity agent harness.
facts.quote: Simple Python scripts to iterate on agentic applications, automate software engineering tasks, and run evaluations on top of the Antigravity agent harness.
